name: Federation of South Arabia (1962–1967)
description: Horizontal stripes of black, green and light blue, the green separated from the blue by narrow yellow stripes, charged at the centre with a white crescent and five-pointed star.
history: Adopted on 4 April 1962 by the Federation of Arab Emirates of the South on its enlargement into the Federation of South Arabia, a British-protected union of Aden and the sheikhdoms of the hinterland. The federation collapsed when the National Liberation Front took power and South Yemen became independent on 30 November 1967.

features.symbolism: the mountains, the desert, the fertile land and the sea
